notes.key_messages:
Candidates would benefit from more practice in the application of numerical skills in a variety of economic
contexts.
notes.general_comments:
The topics that candidates found most accessible were the market economy, factors of production, demand
curve shifts, consumer surplus, externalities and absolute and comparative advantage. Difficulties arose for
more than half of the candidates on elasticity of supply, marginal social benefit, producer surplus and the real
value of money.
